mechanism.claim: In a completed volatile BTC auction, unusually large conditional mutual information from the previous five-minute participation state to the next return sign indicates that turnover is organizing directional price discovery beyond simple return-sign persistence. Follow the sign of the corresponding conditional up-probability lift for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the turnover-conditioned next-up probability lift after conditioning on the previous return sign
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTLRR uses a linear correlation between continuous turnover and the next continuous return. HVVRCR uses same-bar covariance, HVRVSC uses low-frequency cross-spectral coherence, and HVPST fits a continuous temporary-impact regression. HVRVTE instead uses a discrete plug-in conditional mutual information I(turnover_state[t-1]; return_sign[t] | return_sign[t-1]) and a separately frozen conditional probability lift for direction. It uses no taker split, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed block variation must occupy its causal upper thirty-five percent and the information-transfer statistic its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset conditional-information onsets at 01:05, 09:05, and 17:05 UTC are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact epoch-aligned five-minute aggregates from 480 unique coherent BTCUSDT perpetual one-minute rows over [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_return: log(last constituent close/first constituent open), finite and strictly nonzero
features.five_minute_turnover: sum finite strictly positive quote_asset_volume over each group
features.turnover_state: one when five-minute turnover is strictly greater than the within-block numpy median of all 96 turnovers, otherwise zero; both states required
features.return_sign_state: one for a strictly positive five-minute return and zero for a strictly negative return
features.cell_support: each of the four conditioning cells (turnover_state[t-1],return_sign_state[t-1]) contains at least five samples
features.transfer_entropy: empirical plug-in conditional mutual information I(turnover_state[t-1];return_sign_state[t]|return_sign_state[t-1]) using natural logarithms; finite and strictly positive
features.conditional_up_lift: sum over previous-sign z of empirical P(z) times [P(next_up|high_turnover,z)-P(next_up|low_turnover,z)]; finite and strictly nonzero
features.information_rank: strict-prior midrank of transfer_entropy over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared 96 five-minute returns), finite and strictly positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligibility: source-valid, information-rank gate, variation-rank gate, and strict nonzero conditional_up_lift
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous source-valid decision ineligible; insufficient rank history counts as ineligible

clock.feature_available: decision boundary after all 480 source minutes complete
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: fixed discrete participation-to-return-sign conditional-information mechanism under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no discretization, median, lag, conditioning state, cell support, information estimator, lift, rank, variation gate, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: discrete transfer entropy as conditional mutual information
external_basis.fixed_definition: I(X[t-1];Y[t]|Y[t-1]) estimated by empirical frequencies with natural logarithms
external_basis.selection_use: the information-flow statistic only; no incidence or directional outcome claim is imported
